parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning. I’d like to open a bank account please.

Certainly. If you’d like to take a seat I’ll just get some information on our different options for you. It won’t take long./ Thanks.

I’ve got the application form for you here. I see you’ve already got our leaflet. As you can see we have different types of accounts. Is it a current account or a deposit account you want to open today?

A deposit account I suppose? Could you tell me a little more about this type of account? The interest rate for instance.

Sure. Our interest rate is 3.4% which is actually 1.3% higher than other banks. So opening account here is a good choice if you want to save.

And if I wanted to withdraw around $50,000 would I need to wait?

No. But when you withdraw more than $1 million it would be a different process. In the past you had to give a notice 60 days in advance but things are a little different here. You only need to give a 30 day notice.

I see. That's great. Can I ask how much will you be opening your account with?

We usually ask for a minimum sum of $300 but if you have more than $600 you'll have a better interest rate.

Well, I'm going to transfer $1000 from my Dash account just until I get paid.

That's not a problem.

Great. How long should it take to arrange a debit card? A week.

I'm afraid not. The general process of opening the account needs 10 working days but it's usually quite fast. It takes most banks two more days than us.

That's good to know. What should I do if I need to close this account? Do I come back to you or...?

I'm afraid not. My duty as an account administrator is to open the account for you. You'd need to talk to the branch manager about that matter.

And what's the best way to withdraw cash?

Well, as this is a deposit account, if you need cash there are two ways to do that. One is through any ATM of our bank at your convenience. Our bank tells you about a cash withdrawal by phone and by visiting our office.

All right, I will keep that in mind.

I also want to inquire about insurance.

Oh yes, I forgot to mention that. Deposit accounts with over $50,000 come with a life insurance policy free of charge. But if you already have that type of insurance, then you can change the policy to house insurance if you like.

I see. I guess I would go for the latter one.

Hmm. Take your time to think about it. You can let us know if you change your mind. If you're interested, we also have investment schemes available. You can find information about that option in your leaflet. Just give us a call if you want to know more.

Thanks. I think I'll just open the account today. If I want to apply for a credit card, can I also do that today?

Yes, but there is an interview for the application. We usually ask for some information about your credit history and income. If you want to get started, there is a form you can fill in now. It won't take long. We just need to know your personal information, like your name, current address, phone number, social security number and such. We can start the process today and we'll call you in a few days.

All right. Can I have the form, please?

analyses.content: 录音明确提到该银行利率比其他银行高出 1.3%。
Sure. Our interest rate is 3.4% which is actually 1.3% higher than other banks. So opening account here is a good choice if you want to save.
你可能会听到 3.4% 这个干扰项，但那是该银行的总利率，题目问的是“高出”的部分。
In the past you had to give a notice 60 days in advance but things are a little different here. You only need to give a 30 day notice.
注意排除过去规定（60 天）的干扰，要听清表示转折的 "but" 之后的信息。
录音指出目前的规定是需要提前 30 天通知。
We usually ask for a minimum sum of $300 but if you have more than $600 you'll have a better interest rate. Well, I'm going to transfer $1000 from my Dash account just until I get paid.
不要填成 600 或 1000，前者是获得更好利率的门槛，后者是该女士实际要存的金额。
录音中明确提到开户通常要求的最低金额是 300 美元。

Great. How long should it take to arrange a debit card? A week. I'm afraid not. The general process of opening the account needs 10 working days but it's usually quite fast. It takes most banks two more days than us.
不要被“一星期”或“多两天（12天）”这些对话干扰，要抓准描述本行流程的准确数字。
开户的一般流程明确需要 10 个工作日。

What should I do if I need to close this account? Do I come back to you or...? I'm afraid not. My duty as an account administrator is to open the account for you. You'd need to talk to the branch manager about that matter.
你可能想填说话人自己的职位，但他明确说了作为“客户管理员”他不负责关户。
录音提到销户事宜需要找分行经理谈。
题目问的是通过 ATM 或柜员可以进行的操作，录音中指的就是提现。

And what's the best way to withdraw cash? Well, as this is a deposit account, if you need cash there are two ways to do that. One is through any ATM of our bank at your convenience. Our bank tells you about a cash withdrawal by phone and by visiting our office.
注意题目中 to 后面要接动词短语，不要只填了名词。
Deposit accounts with over $50,000 come with a life insurance policy free of charge. But if you already have that type of insurance, then you can change the policy to house insurance if you like.
此处 7 和 8 题是并列关系，听到 "life insurance" 后要迅速准备下一个保险品种。
录音提到存款超过 5 万美元会免费赠送人寿保险。

Deposit accounts with over $50,000 come with a life insurance policy free of charge. But if you already have that type of insurance, then you can change the policy to house insurance if you like. I see. I guess I would go for the latter one.
不要因为后面女士说“选择后者”就漏掉了这个具体的保险名称。
录音提到如果已经有人寿保险，可以将政策改为房屋保险。
If you're interested, we also have investment schemes available. You can find information about that option in your leaflet.
注意单词 schemes 的拼写，且要根据录音使用复数形式。
录音提到除了保险，还有投资方案可供选择。
If I want to apply for a credit card, can I also do that today? Yes, but there is an interview for the application.
你可能会关注到后面提到的申请表（form），但题目问的是“要求的（required）”环节，那是面试。
申请信用卡时必须经过一个面试流程。
